name: kettlebell sumo squat
description: A wide stance squat holding a kettlebell between your legs, working your glutes, inner thighs and quads.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.
